title: Experienced Nurse / Dispenser Needed
qualification: Experienced Nurse or Dispenser with pharmacy setting experience.
eligibility: Only female candidates will be considered.
description:
A private pharmacy in Bulaga, along Mityana Road, is looking for an experienced Nurse or Dispenser to join the team. Pharmacy setting experience is essential.

Only female candidates will be considered, and applicants should have at least one year of experience working in a pharmacy.

To apply, call or send a message to +256 700 904703 to confirm an interview appointment.
summary: Experienced Nurse or Dispenser needed for a private pharmacy in Bulaga, Mityana Road — pharmacy experience essential, female candidates only.
how_to_apply: Call or inbox +256 700 904703 to confirm an interview appointment.
required_documents: CV with 2 referees; photocopy of academic papers; photocopy of your National ID; photocopy of one guardian's National ID; 4 passport photos.
